title: Correct seed-build.md's bundled seed version — doc says 14, seed_version.dart says 15

evidence.quote: the on-device DB when the bundled version is higher. Currently **14**.

why: Low-impact but concretely wrong: the doc's stated current bundled seed version (14) is one behind the actual constant (15), meaning the content DB has been rebuilt/re-seeded at least once since this doc's 'Validation checklist' numbers (113,273 text_cache rows etc., also unverified in this pass) were last confirmed. The rest of the doc — pipeline steps, prerequisites, the 10 merger/resolver mechanics — was checked and is accurate and detailed.
recommendation: Update the 'Currently 14' line to 15 (or better, drop the hardcoded number and point to the constant), and re-verify the row-count table against the current build/seed.db the next time `make seed` runs.
